hook.en: Saying "positively associated" is not enough. Is the link between vaccination and staying healthy weak or strong? *Yule's* Q gives a number for it.

say.en: Saying "positively associated" is not enough. Is the link between vaccination and staying healthy weak or strong? Yule's Q gives a number for it. In this lesson: Compute Yule's coefficient of association.
Interpret its sign and size.

body.en: $Q = [(AB)(\alpha\beta) - (A\beta)(\alpha B)]/[(AB)(\alpha\beta) + (A\beta)(\alpha B)]$. Q = +1 means complete *association*, Q = −1 complete disassociation, Q = 0 independence. Positive Q means positive association, negative Q negative association; the closer to ±1, the stronger.
body.kn: Q = [(AB)(αβ) − (Aβ)(αB)]/[(AB)(αβ) + (Aβ)(αB)]. Q = +1 ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಹಯೋಗ, Q = −1 ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವಿಯೋಗ, Q = 0 ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ. ±1 ಕ್ಕೆ ಹತ್ತಿರವಾದಷ್ಟು ಬಲ.

say.en: Q = [AB(\alpha\beta) - (A\beta)(\alpha B)]/[AB(\alpha\beta) plus (A\beta)(\alpha B)]. Q = plus 1 means complete association, Q equals minus 1 complete disassociation, Q equals 0 independence. Positive Q means positive association, negative Q negative association; the closer to plus or minus 1, the stronger. Diagonal product minus cross product.
say.kn: Q = [ABalpha beta - Abetaalpha B]/[ABalpha beta plus Abetaalpha B]. Q = plus 1 ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಹಯೋಗ, Q equals minus 1 ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವಿಯೋಗ, Q equals 0 ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ. plus or minus 1 ಕ್ಕೆ ಹತ್ತಿರವಾದಷ್ಟು ಬಲ.

Write the four ultimate frequencies in the two by two table.
Multiply along the main diagonal: three fifty times two fifty is eighty-seven thousand five hundred.
Multiply along the other diagonal: two fifty times one fifty is thirty-seven thousand five hundred.
Q is the difference over the sum: fifty thousand by one lakh twenty-five thousand, 0.4. A moderate positive association.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. (AB) = 350, (Aβ) = 250, (αB) = 150, (αβ) = 250. Find Yule's Q.

say.en: Let us work this out together. AB equals 350, Abeta equals 250, alpha B equals 150, alpha beta equals 250. Find Yule's Q.
ABalpha beta equals 87500; Abetaalpha B equals 37500.
Q equals 87500 minus 37500/87500 plus 37500.
So the answer is Q equals 0.4, moderate positive association.

problem.en: Of 400 vaccinated people (A), 20 caught a disease (B); of 400 unvaccinated, 80 caught it. Find Q and interpret.

steps.en: Negative: vaccination and catching the disease are negatively associated.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Of 400 vaccinated people (A), 20 caught a disease (B); of 400 unvaccinated, 80 caught it. Find Q and interpret.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Of 400 vaccinated people A, 20 caught a disease B; of 400 unvaccinated, 80 caught it. Find Q and interpret.
AB equals 20, Abeta equals 380, alpha B equals 80, alpha beta equals 320.
ABalpha beta equals 6400; Abetaalpha B equals 30400.
Q equals 6400 minus 30400/6400 plus 30400 equals minus 24000 over 36800 equals minus 0.652.
Negative: vaccination and catching the disease are negatively associated.
So the answer is Q equals minus 0.65: the vaccine protects.
